title: IMAGO: A family photo album dataset for a socio-historical analysis of the twentieth century
reasoning: The paper analyzes socio-historical categories, one of which is "Rites," described as events pertaining to "the sacred and/or celebratory events which characterize the life of a family." While this may include religious ceremonies, the paper's goal is to classify images into these sociological categories, not to evaluate or benchmark any aspect of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The analysis is purely technical and historical.
